test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which of the following States was the third edition of Khelo India University Games held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The third edition of the **Khelo India University Games** was held in **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• The Khelo India University Games is a part of the **Khelo India initiative**, aimed at promoting sports culture and encouraging young talent in India.
 
• These games provide a platform for university athletes to showcase their skills and compete at a national level.
 
• The event features competitions in various sports disciplines, fostering a spirit of sportsmanship and national pride among participants.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Khelo India initiative was launched by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, Government of India, to revive the sports culture in India at the grassroots level.
 
• It aims to build a strong framework for all sports played in our country and establish India as a great sporting nation.
 
• The first edition of the Khelo India University Games was held in **Odisha **in **2020**.
 
• The initiative also includes the Khelo India Youth Games and Khelo India School Games, catering to different age groups.
 
• Through these games, the government aims to identify and nurture sporting talent from a young age and provide them with the necessary support and infrastructure to excel.
